Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, P. SATHASIVAM
A B Penal Code, 1860 - 302, 307, 452 rlw s.34 - Family dispute between parties, leading to fatal assault on one and grievous hurt to other- Conviction ulss 302, 307, 452 rw s.34 c by courts below - Correctness of - Held: Testimony of eyewitnesses as also injured witness clear, cogent and credible - Evidence. According to the prosecution case, family dispute and litigation between the family of the complainant-PW D 9 and the accused resulted in fatal assault on complainant's husband and grievous hurt to PW-11. PW- 9 lodged a complaint. Investigations were carred out. Trial court
Decision Date : 15-01-2008 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 95/2008 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
